issues.description: nevra[0] indexes the first character of the filename, not the package name's first letter — correct under tight precondition, undefined under any other.
issues.detail: The koji path layout requires the first letter of the package NAME, lowercased. nevra[0] takes the first character of the basename of the URL. The precondition that the URL basename equals the NEVRA RPM filename is asserted nowhere. If a URL ever carries a leading path segment, a digit-prefixed name, or upper-case, the constructed path is silently wrong. State the precondition or compute the name properly.

issues.description: extract_arch_from_url returns None on failure and the caller proceeds to build a URL containing the string 'None'.
issues.detail: The postcondition of extract_arch_from_url is unstated, and the caller in use_koji_url_only does not test the result. When the regex fails to match, f"/latest/{arch}/Packages" produces '/latest/None/Packages' and a broken URL is silently appended. Either raise on failure or have the caller refuse to continue. Defensive None-return as substitute for correctness.

issues.description: Author admits a race condition with koji tagging and offers no invariant under which the constructed URL is guaranteed to resolve.
issues.detail: The commit message concedes that the URL is crafted before the artifact is tagged into coreos-pool. There is no stated invariant ('after bump-lockfile merge and before consumer fetch, every NEVRA is reachable at the canonical path'), no termination bound on the race window, no detection. 'It is safe' is asserted, not reasoned. TESTED-NOT-PROVED, and not even tested locally by the author's own admission.

issues.description: Word-boundary arch regex will misclassify any URL whose path segment contains an arch substring before the real arch.
issues.detail: search() returns the first match. A repository path such as .../ppc64le-mirror/.../x86_64/Packages/... would yield 'ppc64le' though the package is x86_64. The function has no precondition restricting where the arch may appear in the URL, and no postcondition tying the returned arch to the package's actual arch. The arch should be threaded in from the caller, which already knows it.

issues.description: Hard-coded koji_url_base and arch list are scattered constants without a single source of truth.
issues.detail: The arch list in extract_arch_from_url is independent of the arches the caller iterates over in generate_main, and the koji URL base is a string literal embedded in logic. A change to either invalidates the other silently. The frame of what may vary is not stated. Lift to module constants with a stated precondition that both lists agree.

issues.description: Stale comment block about DNF5 bug removed, but the prioritization logic it justified remains without explanation.
issues.detail: The 'Prioritize the url from fedora-coreos-pool' branch in query_packages_location now exists with no rationale, since the new pass in use_koji_url_only rewrites everything anyway. Either the prioritization is now dead work and should be removed, or it is load-bearing and the comment should say why. Leaving both is a smuggled assumption.

review.summary: This patch substitutes a string-mangling routine for the correctness it claims to provide. The author has not stated the precondition that input URLs end in a well-formed NEVRA filename, nor the postcondition that the constructed koji path resolves; both are required for use_koji_url_only to be meaningful. extract_arch_from_url returns None silently and the caller embeds it verbatim — a textbook defensive-as-substitute failure. The acknowledged race with koji tagging is described as 'safe' without an invariant. REFUSED in current form; the discipline is missing, even if the resulting URLs happen to work most of the time.
